suggested_issue_title: Aspose.3D FOSS for TypeScript: test_3mf_materials.test.ts reads a fixture outside the repository, so npx jest fails
suggested_issue_body:
## Summary

`npx jest` runs 97 tests and 4 fail. `Test3MFMaterialImport > testMaterialImport` fails because `tests/test_3mf_materials.test.ts` opens a fixture from a directory outside this repository (`../foss.3d.python/examples/3mf/`). The other three failures have their own causes (STL export, binary GLB export and `Transform.transformMatrix`) and are described in separate reports.

## Environment

- Revision `66cb26df3b031f0bf6976d4e88dc89721983afa4` (default branch `master`)
- Node.js v22.23.3 and npm 10.9.9 (Docker image `node:22-slim`, Linux); the same results on Windows with Node.js v22.11.0
- `npm install` and `npm run build` complete without errors; verified on 2026-10-16

## Steps to reproduce

```sh
git clone https://github.com/aspose-3d-foss/Aspose.3D-FOSS-for-TypeScript
cd Aspose.3D-FOSS-for-TypeScript
npm install
npx jest tests/test_3mf_materials.test.ts
```

## Expected

The test reads a fixture that is part of the repository and passes.

## Actual result

```
Test3MFMaterialImport > testMaterialImport
  ENOENT: no such file or directory, open '../foss.3d.python/examples/3mf/dodeca_chain_loop_color.3mf'
```

The whole suite (`npx jest`) reports:

```
Test Suites: 4 failed, 28 passed, 32 total
Tests:       4 failed, 93 passed, 97 total
```

## Where in the repository

- `tests/test_3mf_materials.test.ts:14` (`const filePath = '../foss.3d.python/examples/3mf/dodeca_chain_loop_color.3mf';`)
- `tests/` holds five 3MF test files and no `.3mf` fixture

## Suggested fix

Add the fixture under `tests/` and read it relative to `__dirname`, or generate a small 3MF file in the test. Running `npx jest` in CI would show the other three failures as well.
